title: How to Make Anomalies in Project P.I.T.T. — Phase 4 Recipe & Workbench Fixes
description: Phase 4 recipe, workbench fixes, and Piñata staging tips for making Anomalies in Project P.I.T.T.
h1: How to Make Anomalies in Project P.I.T.T. — Phase 4 Recipe & Workbench Fixes
quickAnswer: Recipe: Duck + Cash Register + Piñata at the Anomaly workbench. Complete one successful manual Anomaly before scaling automation.

facts.label: Recipe
facts.value: Observed recipe: Duck + Cash Register + Piñata at the Anomaly workbench.

facts.label: Workbench issue
facts.value: All three inputs must truly enter the corresponding workbench process — not merely arrive nearby; misalignment or multiple inputs can make the workbench appear not to work and automation can amplify jams.

facts.label: Piñata
facts.value: Piñata is fragile during transport and can break before reaching the workbench; stage and secure it to avoid breakage.
